WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID,
           AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL
       AND AVG(HCT) IS NOT NULL
       AND AVG(HCT) <> 0
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg
    FROM patient_ratios
), first_kept AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, o.overall_avg,
           p.ratio - o.overall_avg AS above_overall
    FROM patient_ratios p
    CROSS JOIN overall o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.overall_avg
), second_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS kept_avg
    FROM first_kept
), final_kept AS (
    SELECT f.ratio, f.above_overall, f.ratio - s.kept_avg AS above_second
    FROM first_kept f
    CROSS JOIN second_avg s
    WHERE f.ratio > s.kept_avg
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio,
       AVG(above_overall) AS average_amount_above_overall,
       AVG(above_second) AS average_amount_above_second
FROM final_kept;

assumptions.assumption: Each patient’s ratio is the average of their nonmissing HGB values divided by the average of their nonmissing HCT values; patients missing either average are excluded. The overall and second-stage averages are unweighted averages of patient ratios.
